subject.title: docs(cli): generate and guard command reference

question: Should OpenClaw ship the generated command reference on the proposed public command inventory and plugin CLI metadata contract, or narrow the initial catalog scope?
rationale: The permanent plugin API, default public exposure semantics, and downstream prompt/docs consumers are compatibility and product choices that implementation tests cannot settle.

options.title: Approve and harden the full contract
options.body: Accept the proposed catalog API, then fix complete docs scheduling, isolate the final slice, and require exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Start with core-only inventory
options.body: Limit the initial CLI and generated reference to core descriptors while deferring public plugin metadata and broader consumers.

options.title: Pause until RFC resolution
options.body: Keep this dependent draft inactive until the RFC and foundation PR establish the permanent direction.

recommendation.title: Approve and harden the full contract
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed catalog API, then fix complete docs scheduling, isolate the final slice, and require exact-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent CLI/plugin history and repository ownership provide the strongest available routing signal for this cross-cutting API decision.
